paragraphs: Redstone Technologies LLC describes itself as a technology firm offering artificial intelligence-based solutions for complex transportation projects. The home page states that the company works with railroads and transportation agencies on operational hurdles through software, AI integration, and specialized research. Services listed cover custom software for heavy rail, AI deployments aimed at transit efficiency, and technical services tailored to the transportation sector.

The about page says the firm is the exclusive licensee of AI and analytics technology developed at Rutgers University. Its stated mission is modernizing the rail and transportation industry by developing software and hardware solutions. Described work includes edge computing for trespasser detection and nationwide asset monitoring systems.

The team is described as licensed Professional Engineers and experts who have managed infrastructure grants. A data-driven analytics platform is described as deployed across the national rail network.

quote.text: As the exclusive licensee of Rutgers-developed AI technology, we transform elite research into field-ready transportation solutions.
